answer: Use a watershed trust that only thaws slowly, like a glacier feeding a river. A newcomer applying for paid work must complete eight verified jobs over 28 days, each confirmed by a different client, and lock a 1,000 POA watershed bond for the full period. If two identities share a client, a payout route, or a timing pattern, both bonds are burned and both are barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 100,000 POA before earning anything. A walnut grower proving a single orchard harvest season after season earns trust the same way, without shortcuts.
